introHtml: Cotton poly blends combine the softness of cotton with the durability of polyester, making them ideal for school spirit apparel that withstands frequent wear and washing. Whether you need custom T-shirts for game days or hoodies for pep rallies, this fabric holds vibrant screen-printed logos and embroidery exceptionally well. It resists shrinking and wrinkles, keeping your school colors looking sharp all season long.
